question.text: Which of the following is correct?

options.text: a liquid with low vapour pressure will have a low surface tension and high boiling point
a liquid with high vapour pressure will have high intermolecular forces and high boiling point
a liquid with low vapour pressure will have high surface tension and high boiling point
a liquid with low vapour pressure will have low surface tension and low boiling point

solution.text: A liquid with low vapour pressure (less volatile) will have a high surface tension and high boiling point.
